description: This file contains function declarations, templates, and implementations related to probability distributions, including gamma, beta, and Dirichlet reparameterized gradients, with platform-specific compatibility code for CUDA and HIP.

classes.name: BaseSampler
classes.description: Template struct for sampling functions, capturing a sampler function and providing a sample method.

methods.name: sample_gamma
methods.description: Samples from a gamma distribution using Marsaglia and Tsang's acceptance-rejection method.

methods.name: stirling_approx_tail
methods.description: Approximates tail values for Stirling's approximation used in binomial sampling.

methods.name: binomial_inversion
methods.description: Performs binomial sampling via inversion method.

methods.name: btrs
methods.description: Samples from a binomial distribution using transformed rejection sampling.

methods.name: sample_binomial
methods.description: Samples from a binomial distribution, choosing method based on parameters.

methods.name: digamma_one
methods.description: Computes the digamma function with asymptotic expansion and approximations.

methods.name: standard_gamma_grad_one
methods.description: Calculates the reparameterized gradient of the gamma distribution's CDF with respect to alpha.

methods.name: dirichlet_grad_one
methods.description: Computes scaled reparameterized gradients for the Dirichlet distribution.
